competing_explanation: If the extra 1st-order chord probe forward pass on BF16 channels-last Conv2d/BatchNorm2d costs nearly as much as EMPF's 2-endpoint create_graph=True double-backward pass, then dcgan_performance_r256 median update latency will remain >= 130 ms instead of dropping below 100 ms.
hypothesis: Eliminating 2nd-order autograd.grad(..., create_graph=True) double-backpropagation via live 1st-order endpoint reuse + one 1st-order Chebyshev-Weyl chord probe reduces dcgan_performance_r256 median update time from 155.41 ms (empf-v8), 339.64 ms (bispf), 588.75 ms (rhbi-v12), and 3112.91 ms (bcap) down to <= 100.0 ms while lowering peak GPU memory on NVIDIA RTX A6000.
